about: Custom Game: game types, the Realm's event styles and the world sizes. js/game/modes.js reads this; js/main.js draws the setup screen from it. lands = recipe ids a type may use (omit for all). opts = which choices the setup screen shows.

realm.name: Realm
realm.blurb: A world that keeps going. Your people's faith feeds your mana and pays Essence while events come and go.

td.name: Tower Defense
td.blurb: Enemies march on your keep. Build towers, shape their route with walls, and hold out wave after wave.

wildfire.name: Wildfire Watch
wildfire.blurb: Fires keep breaking out and the wind keeps turning. Save the forest and your village for as long as you can.

flood.name: Rising Tide
flood.blurb: Surges pour in from the edge of the world, each bigger than the last. Raise banks, dig channels, keep your people alive.

cataclysm.name: Cataclysm
cataclysm.blurb: The kingdoms forgot you. Bring them down before the clock runs out: everything you can do to a world, in one go.

garden.name: Wild Garden
garden.blurb: An empty land and no one to protect. Bring creatures in and keep them alive together: every living kind feeds your mana.

sandbox.name: Sandbox
sandbox.blurb: No goals and no threats. Build a city, or burn it down.

random.name: Random
random.blurb: Raids, omens, disasters and blessings, in no order.

peaceful.name: Peaceful
peaceful.blurb: No enemies. Good harvests, travellers and blessings. Slow and kind.

waves.name: Wave Defense
waves.blurb: Numbered waves on a timer, stronger each time. Pays best for holding on.

disasters.name: Disasters
disasters.blurb: No raiders: the world itself turns on you. Storms, quakes, meteors, fire.
